data.content: Implemented schema v21 durable immutable outbox receipts, credential-scoped writer epochs, legacy quarantine inventory, exact-ref lease publication, exact remote OID acknowledgement, and lost-ack recovery. Compatibility files remain retained and replica trees are never scanned by the v2 publisher. Commit 8361bc68 is published in GitHub PR #105 with Sneka attribution. make sanity passed with 1,318 unit tests and 95.11% coverage; released v0.17.6 and focused two-clone/crash/rotation tests passed.
